The bug was in `rotate_file` in `boltons/fileutils.py`, and all 13 tests in `tests/test_fileutils.py` now pass.

**Cause:** The function renamed each file up by one, then deleted the highest-numbered backup (`kept_names[-1]`). After the renames, that file was no longer the oldest one. It was the newest rotation, sitting in the last slot. With `keep=1`, this deleted the backup that had just been made. With a full set of backups, it deleted the oldest kept file, which made the full-rotation tests fail with `FileNotFoundError`.

**Fix:** I moved the removal of the oldest backup to before the rename loop, so only the file that falls beyond `keep` is dropped. I removed the old deletion that ran after the renames.
